purpose: Turn existing research into dated, falsifiable KR/US research decisions (B0 ETF / B1 existing rule / B2 AI synthesis) and compare them prospectively on 126 and 252 sessions. Research and virtual portfolios only.
authorExposureDisclosure: Before freezing these rules the author had seen the production weekly receipts' candidate names, alpha percentiles and entry states for KR 2026-11-06 and US 2026-11-10, and the first watchlist rows. No forward return of any candidate was looked up. The gates below were written to the existing research verdicts, not to those names.
doesNotAuthorize: any production weight, risk limit or receipt change
writing to signal-history or any external store (dry-run only until the Owner approves activation)
promotion of any rejected model or exploratory strategy

comparisonOnly.US: QQQ (separate growth benchmark; never substituted for SPY)

B1.name: Existing permitted rule
B1.definition: the production weekly-passive-first-v1 receipt of the same cohort, copied byte-identically by digest; today it is 100% ETF in both regions because ordering is not established
observationComparators: kr-selection-challenger-v2-accounting CH_VALUE_CONFIRMED book (prospective research, not B1)
US macro cocktail S4/D1/D3/D6 (historical-only, not a current stock path)

B2.name: AI synthesis (Claude, structured)
B2.definition: an AI reads the cohort's production evidence pack and existing research verdicts and selects 0-5 names under the gates below; zero is an explicit choice

cohort.rule: for each calendar month M and region R, the first production receipt with weekStatus FINAL_WEEKLY and asOfDate in M
cohort.informationCutoff: the regional close of that receipt's asOfDate; only evidence that existed in the published receipt or in sources dated on/before the cutoff may be used
cohort.generatedAt: wall-clock time the B2 review is written; must be after the receipt's generatedAt
cohort.publishedAt: git commit time of the record on a public branch; must precede plannedExecution
cohort.plannedExecution: regional close of the first session whose close is after publishedAt
cohort.lateRecord: if publishedAt is after the next cohort's informationCutoff the record is LATE_NOT_PROSPECTIVE and is kept but never scored

portfolio.noConvictionWeights: weights are fixed by count; the AI does not size
portfolio.holding: each cohort is held unchanged to its horizon; cohorts overlap and are scored independently

costs.source: the cohort receipt's own costs block (pipeline/benchmark_alpha REALISTIC_COSTS, dated sell tax)
costs.charge: each stock leg pays stockRoundTripPct once; the ETF residual pays benchmarkRoundTripPct once; B0 pays benchmarkRoundTripPct

returns.basis: total return from split-adjusted close plus dated cash distributions
returns.fillRule: a horizon is filled only after its end session has closed and has been observed; before that it is PENDING
returns.corporateActions: a name with an unverifiable corporate action, suspension or delisting inside the horizon makes the cohort SOURCE_BLOCKED; never 0%, never last-price exit
returns.currency: local currency (KRW for KR, USD for US); KRW translation of US cohorts is reported separately with the H.10 release rule

b2Gates.G1_DATA: freshness.status == FRESH and coverage.dataCompleteness >= 0.75 and coverage.sleevesPresent >= 3
b2Gates.G5_LEVERAGE: valuationProfitability.debtToEquity < 200 unless sector is Financial Services / Real Estate / Utilities
b2Gates.G6_CONCENTRATION: at most portfolio.maxNamesPerSector per sector and at most portfolio.maxNames in total
b2Gates.vetoIsFinal: a gated name cannot be selected whatever the AI argues

b2Layers.industry: sector of the name, sector representation among top candidates
b2Layers.price: valuation (forward/trailing PE, fcfYield), 12-1 and 63-day momentum, 52-week-high distance
b2Layers.macro: US 10y yield level/change, curve, dollar (UUP), gold, VIX; KR adds USD/KRW
b2Layers.research: existing verdicts: four-factor alpha ordering NOT established (KR rank IC t 0.68, US t 0.17); momentum/industry momentum phase-dependent; value-confirmation exploratory; US dynamic ETF allocation not better than static
b2Layers.risk: drawdown, volatility, sector concentration, event risk, trading cost
b2Layers.labels: each layer is SUPPORTS / NEUTRAL / CONTRADICTS from the listed observations; interpretation text is kept separate from the observed numbers
b2Layers.selectionRule: a name passing every gate needs >= 3 SUPPORTS layers and no CONTRADICTS in company, price or risk; a CONTRADICTS market layer caps the region at 2 names

b2Output.forbiddenReason: no calibrated statistical basis exists for an AI-stated probability or target; numbers of that kind are refused by the validator
b2Output.knowledgeLimit: the AI's background knowledge has a training cutoff before the decision date; any catalyst it names from memory is NOT_VERIFIED and labelled so

ledger.appendOnly: records are never edited or deleted; outcomes are separate OUTCOME rows that reference a record digest
ledger.chain: each record carries the previous record's digest; the verifier recomputes every digest and link
ledger.activation: OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; until then records are written only under research/decision_desk_v1/dry-run/

evaluationPlan.primary: per-cohort excess total return of B1 and B2 over B0 after costs at h126 and h252
evaluationPlan.honestPower: 6-12 months gives at most 6-12 overlapping monthly cohorts; results are reported as a record of behaviour and reliability, never as proof of alpha
evaluationPlan.failureAdmission: a B2 name is judged wrong at the horizon if its cost-adjusted return trails the regional ETF, or earlier if a recorded invalidation condition is observed; both are logged, nothing is deleted
